mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressures that lead to tighter monetary policy, which in turn increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5% signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage pressures and reduces corporate profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 5% and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals strong economic growth, boosting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 increases for two consecutive quarters and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% YoY signals a weakening supply side of the economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO YoY < -2% and S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening economy, boosting consumer confidence and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST > 650 & UNRATE < 8% and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy, reducing borrowing costs and increasing investment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases by > 0.25% in 3 months and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 in a month signals strong labor market conditions, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases by > 200,000 and S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over two consecutive months signals strong consumer demand, boosting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases for two consecutive months
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases for two consecutive months and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances.
